title: Remove the Pods shared datastore and its retired data
goal: Remove shared namespace storage, its work graph and dependent interfaces while preserving independently running Pods.
summary: Delete the 20 unused namespaces and their 2,262 records, revisions and work history through a tested migration. Remove the feature from runtime, APIs, CLI/MCP and UI; retain private Pod files, checkpoints and external authorization.

problem.statement: No current non-archived Pod uses the shared datastore, but the product still exposes and maintains it.
problem.impact: Retired mail content remains stored and unused work-graph infrastructure complicates execution, deletion and the UI.
problem.approach: Perform one coordinated retirement across storage, execution, administration and presentation, with an upgrade rehearsal before live cleanup.
problem.outcome: Current Pods continue with their existing files and external services; the shared-data feature and its live records are gone.

context: Live inspection at 19:12 Europe/Vienna found 21 active Pods, one paused Pod and the archived Mail-Prüfung. All 20 namespaces have no readers; three result writers point only to that archived Pod. The five briefing Pods now use daily files. Canonical origin/main is 6b0f06ba9a4be13733d5226bf1baebef29224b60; the shared main checkout is older and contains unrelated untracked work.
scope: Purge live namespace definitions, readers, records, revisions, declared work, work items and namespace-bound owner questions.
Remove context.data, context.work, namespace-bound context.decisions, work exports and domain administration across desktop, CLI/MCP and browser contracts.
Remove obsolete graph edges, counters, queue logic, documentation and fixtures; update relay snapshots and protocol compatibility where affected.
Deliver through a canonical native PR, required local checks and a coordinated release/install with verified live cleanup.
nonGoals: Do not replace the shared store with another data service or rewrite personal Pod recipes.
Retain private workspaces, checkpoints, assigned directories, credentials, identities, IdP grants and effect receipts.
Do not discard the ten unrelated historical IURIO approvals, external mail journals, private briefing files or owner-created exports. Existing backups remain recovery artifacts, not active storage.
Do not delete archived Pod identities or rewrite immutable historical migrations and run logs solely to remove old API text.

milestones.title: Freeze the retirement boundary
milestones.goal: Bind the implementation to current source and a fresh dependency inventory.
steps: After approval, create a native implementation issue linked to the relevant storage part of issue 1517 and use a feature/issue-<number>-remove-shared-datastore branch from current canonical main. Preserve other checkouts.

Reinspect active scripts, running commands and registered runtimes before destructive migration. Use existing backup facilities to capture a consistent private recovery baseline; record unrelated state for comparison.
acceptance: No non-archived script requires the retired APIs and no shared work is claimed or has an unknown external outcome; otherwise stop before deleting.
milestones.rollback: No product or live data has changed in this milestone.

milestones.title: Remove the feature across its consumers
milestones.goal: Keep the ordinary Pod execution and authorization path independent of shared data.
steps: Remove domain storage/work/question services and dispatch ports, work-aware scheduling, script manifest fields and MCP/CLI commands. Update IPC, preload, native/browser adapters and the runtime reference together.
Remove shared-data presentation and update relay snapshot validation/cleanup. Keep existing grant decisions and historical approval visibility through an independent retained path.

Reject imports or activation of obsolete scripts with a clear removed-feature error before effects; do not silently ignore old work declarations. Update current guides and the local openape-pods skill guidance.
acceptance: No supported surface advertises, creates, reads or writes shared namespaces; current file/CLI/HTTP Pods keep their execution path.
milestones.rollback: Before migration, revert the feature branch or install the previous build against its matching unmodified profile.

milestones.title: Purge retired data through a versioned upgrade
milestones.goal: Remove the complete live data graph without touching unrelated state.
steps: Add an ordered transactional migration to remove shared tables and dependent triggers/indexes, plus affected central snapshot copies. Preserve action approvals, effect receipts, run history, credentials and private progress.
Rehearse an old populated database upgrade, a clean profile, repeated startup, interruption rollback and refusal with a dependent active script. Verify exact unrelated-state parity.
Retire or reject pending old-domain commands and older writers so reconnect or restore cannot silently recreate removed state. Existing backups are not advertised as erased.
acceptance: The 20 live namespaces, 2,262 current entries and their revisions/work/question state are absent after upgrade; a repeat changes nothing.
Unrelated Pod settings, private state, approvals and effect receipts match the baseline; stale clients cannot resurrect the feature.
milestones.rollback: A destructive schema upgrade requires the matching pre-upgrade application and consistent backup. Do not overwrite newer runs or rotated credentials with an old profile; reconcile intervening effects before restoration.

milestones.title: Verify and install the retired feature state
milestones.goal: Make the installed product and live storage match the approved result.
steps: Run focused storage, worker, scheduling, CLI/MCP and relay tests; browser/component tests cover changed presentation. Build affected apps and run the mandatory affected unit gate; pnpm check:ci precedes deployment.

Merge with explicit native issue/PR relation and reviewed SHAs. Roll out relay compatibility first if needed, drain native runs, install through the established owner build workflow and apply the upgrade once.

Check live table/snapshot absence, current Pod configuration and ordinary execution without duplicate effects. Publish actual evidence under Test Runs, update this same Plan and close only the completed issue scope.
acceptance: Installed runtime, CLI/MCP and UI no longer offer shared storage; representative independent Pods still run and cleanup is verified locally and centrally.
milestones.rollback: Use the tested migration recovery procedure and retained previous binaries; do not replay effects or restore obsolete credentials blindly.

decisions.title: Retire rather than extend shared-data administration
decisions.description: The owner approved proposal revision 1. Implement cleanup as part of complete retirement without adding permanent namespace administration.
decisions.reference: Passt. Dann kannst du den altbestand nun wegräumen. Entferne auch das Feature der gemeinsamen Datenspeicher. Wir brauchen es ja nicht mehr

risks.title: Coupled approvals and shared-data services
risks.mitigation: The existing domain overview also exposes ten historical IURIO approvals. Separate and preserve them, together with IdP grants and effect receipts, before deleting datastore services.

risks.title: Concurrent activity and older runtime profiles
risks.mitigation: Recheck actual dependencies at the migration boundary; perform no direct SQL edits against the running desktop and no silent data drop for a still-dependent profile.

verification: Activate . ./scripts/activate-node.sh in each repository shell, then pnpm run doctor. Follow apps/openape-pods/docs/testing.md for the narrowest existing test suites.
Use real SQLite upgrade fixtures for atomicity, idempotence and unrelated-data preservation; use anonymous synthetic scripts for API and scheduling regression checks.
Source search excludes immutable historical migrations and archived evidence. New profiles must not create shared-data tables; old profiles must lose them through upgrade.

Implementation and focused acceptance are complete: 11 storage migration tests, 16 browser tests and one real Electron schema-53 startup passed. Lint, typecheck and application build passed. The required pre-push gate and production cleanup remain pending.

sections.body: Primary paths: `apps/openape-pods/src/worker/data/{domain,work,questions,admin,ports}.ts`, `worker/storage/schema.ts`, `worker/runs/{dispatcher,script-context}.ts`, `worker/scheduling/scheduler.ts`, `worker/workspace/map-view.ts`, `contracts/domain-*`, IPC/preload and `renderer/central/*`. Trace the CLI/MCP actions and `worker/master/reference.ts`; inspect `apps/openape-pods-relay/server/utils/workspace-store.ts` and shared snapshot contracts for retained copies. Use a fresh implementation worktree; the current shared main checkout must not be switched or cleaned.

evidence.title: Read-only live baseline, October 20, 2026
evidence.text: Runtime a2521095-eaee-4c92-9214-d3988ef3430d online. 23 Pods: 21 active, 1 paused, 1 archived. No non-archived script calls context.data/context.work/context.decisions or exports work; no namespace readers. 16 delta-mind/mail namespaces: 2225 entries; 4 patrick/briefing namespaces: 37 entries. 11 retained work operations; no claimed or unknown work. 0 pending namespace owner questions. 10 unrelated historical IURIO approvals retained. Runtime domain contract only supports deleting individual owner records; no complete namespace purge. Canonical origin/main inspected: 6b0f06ba9a4be13733d5226bf1baebef29224b60. Toolchain doctor passed with unrelated untracked files preserved.

completion.summary: Implementation has started; feature removal and live cleanup are not yet complete.
